profile.headline: Software Engineer at Capital One | Payment Systems & Real-Time Data Infrastructure | Python, Java, Go | AWS Certified
profile.summary:
Software engineer who switched from Electrical Engineering and fell in love with building systems that can't afford to fail.

At Capital One, I build backend infrastructure across data engineering and payment systems, streaming pipelines, database platforms, disaster recovery tooling, and reconciliation systems. I focus on reliability, scalability, and building things that other teams can reuse.

Before software, I spent 5 years as an electrical engineer at Lockheed Martin Skunkworks, WSP, and EK Fox designing systems for aircraft then commercial and government facilities. That background shaped how I think about fault tolerance and production-grade engineering.

Always learning, always building.

Technologies: Python, Go, Java, PySpark, Scala, Swift, AWS, Apache Kafka, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Terraform, Docker
